% tab_multichip, note. Generated by paper-v4/tools/make_tables.py; do not edit.
All runs use 118 residues on a slice with eight chips visible. Throughput is the queries per call divided by the steady-state call. We give no throughput for the rows that time \texttt{predict} or for the external ensemble, which computes one query. Chips with data counts the chips with nonzero HBM in use. Not kept marks a value that is missing from the summary. For automatic partitioning, each run kept one HBM value, and we do not know whether it is a mean over the chips or the value of chip~0. MB is 1,000,000 bytes. Rows differ in script, so ratios between rows are not speedups. Alphabet and fixed are the repeated-alphabet and fixed sequences. Times keep the decimals that the scripts round to, including trailing zeros.
